yt_title: This Week's Rarest Odds, Ranked: 1 in 9 to 1 in 8×10^67
yt_description:
What are the rarest odds in everyday life? This week's 15 most shocking odds ranked from everyday to impossible: being left-handed (1 in 9), a hole-in-one (1 in 12,500), the Powerball (1 in 292 million) and the exact order of a shuffled deck (1 in 8 x 10^67).

Sources: Papadatou-Pastou et al. 2020; Harvard Crimson; NCAA Research; NASA; National Hole-in-One Registry via PGA.com; National Weather Service; NSC Injury Facts 2024; Florida Museum ISAF; official Powerball odds; dice and card math.
